test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find a single discount (rounded up to two decimal places) to equal three consecutive discounts of 29%, 28% and 13%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discount multiplier = (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂) × (1 − d₃)

Net multiplier = (1 − 0.29) × (1 − 0.28) × (1 − 0.13) = 0.71 × 0.72 × 0.87

Net multiplier = 0.5112 × 0.87 = 0.444744

Single equivalent discount = (1 − 0.444744) × 100 = 55.5256%

Rounding up to two decimal places, we get 55.53%.

**∴ The correct answer is 55.53%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → Discounts are **29%**, **28%**, and **13%**.
Formulas: Successive discount for two = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b290cdc9af90f4b720f75443977a7b8ff797f9755e893583c410d1e1b823430.png] 
⇒ First two discounts: 29 + 28 − (29 × 28) ÷ 100 = 57 − 8.12 = 48.88%
⇒ Combine with third: 48.88 + 13 − (48.88 × 13) ÷ 100
⇒ 61.88 − 6.3544 = 55.5256%
⇒ Rounding to two decimal places = 55.53%

**∴ The correct answer is 55.53%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When multiple discounts are applied one after another, the net discount is less than the sum of individual percentages because each subsequent discount is calculated on the reduced price.

Rounding Rules

When rounding to two decimal places, if the third decimal is 5 or greater, the second decimal digit is incremented by 1.</p
